title: Sections of a finite locally free module on an affine open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $M$ be a finite locally free $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. If $U\subseteq X$ is an affine open, then the module of sections $\Gamma(U,M)$ is finitely presented and projective over the ring $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$.
